title: Possibility to give an application exclusively audio output
line: Each app in the Audio Volume widget now has a "Mute Other Applications" action that silences every other app at once.
explanation: The Audio Volume widget only let you mute applications one by one, so letting a single app play alone (music at an event, a presentation) meant muting every other stream by hand or the reporter's workaround of a dummy default output. With a single output device, the per-application menu didn't even exist. The stream menu (ListItemMenu) now offers "Mute Other Applications" on every playback stream when other applications are playing; it mutes all other non-virtual playback streams except the ones from the same application, and is greyed out when they are already muted. The menu button now also shows up whenever there is another application playing.

commits.message:
applet: add an action to mute all other applications

There was no quick way to let a single application play alone, which
is handy when playing music at an event or giving a presentation. Each
playback stream's menu now has an action that mutes all other apps.

BUG: 478834
